overview_description.description: Flexport offers ocean and air freight services, customs brokerage, trucking coordination, and fulfillment solutions for both direct-to-consumer and business shipments. Its technology platform delivers shipment tracking, SKU-level visibility, cost management tools, and centralized documentation across international and domestic supply chains. Flexport also supports customs clearance and trade compliance through brokerage services and data-driven insights.

press_references.value: Technology | Bay Area tech company accuses former employees of stealing trade secrets to start rival firm

legal_proceedings.description: Flexport, a Bay Area shipping-technology company, has filed a lawsuit against former employees Bryan Lacaillade and Yingwei 'Jason' Zhao, accusing them of stealing trade secrets to start a rival company, Freightmate. The lawsuit, filed in San Francisco U.S. District Court, alleges that the two ex-employees misappropriated sensitive commercial documents and copyrighted code from Flexport to build Freightmate. Flexport seeks damages and a court order to prevent the use or disclosure of the stolen trade secrets.

about_short_description.short_description: Flexport provides an end-to-end global logistics platform that coordinates freight movement from manufacturers to delivery destinations.

product.name: Flexport Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for coordinating global logistics, with shipment management, SKU-level visibility, supply chain data, and execution workflows from suppliers through delivery.

product.name: Freight Forwarding Control Tower
product.description: A logistics control tower that uses shipment data and machine-learning-based consolidation and routing to manage air and ocean freight, costs, capacity, and delivery deadlines.

product.name: Ocean Freight
product.description: Ocean freight forwarding for full-container-load shipments and ocean consolidation, with booking support, shipment tracking, customs coordination, and delivery management.

product.name: Customs Brokerage
product.description: Licensed customs brokerage and customs technology for preparing entries, clearing imported goods, managing duties, and improving trade compliance.

product.name: Omnichannel Fulfillment
product.description: Fulfillment services that use a shared inventory pool and fulfillment-center network to support e-commerce orders, wholesale distribution, and customer returns.

product.name: Air Freight
product.description: Air freight forwarding for urgent or time-sensitive cargo, including tailored capacity planning, shipment updates, reporting, and charter services.
